subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should extension-relay target IDs remain stable public tab handles across renderer detach/reattach, or should detach deliberately make callers reselect despite the previously shipped relay continuation behavior?
rationale: The PR removes a route heuristic correctly, but choosing between a relay-owned stable identity and an intentional compatibility break belongs to the browser/relay owner rather than a route-level repair.

options.title: Preserve relay-stable continuity
options.body: Implement the relay-owned stable handle and return its authoritative post-operation outcome, with a real detach/reattach regression test and live proof.

options.title: Accept stale-handle semantics
options.body: Document that relay renderer replacement invalidates the returned target and requires explicit reselection, accepting the compatibility break for existing relay workflows.

recommendation.title: Preserve relay-stable continuity
recommendation.body: Implement the relay-owned stable handle and return its authoritative post-operation outcome, with a real detach/reattach regression test and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical report defines the relay identity contract and its required regression matrix.
